headline: Highest risk is medium data/capability overlap: both agents are docs-only, non-runnable, and show no shared I/O surfaces, so pairwise harms are limited and mostly hypothetical.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel, filesystem, clipboard, or MCP surface is documented for either nuwa-skill or risingwave. With both profiles lacking io_surfaces and being non-runnable, there is no plausible default injection path between them.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue is later configured between the two agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Do not bridge outputs through copy-paste automation.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared channel is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles touch no data classes and expose no shared workspace or authenticated principal. nuwa-skill has allowlisted egress while risingwave has none, so leakage between them is not evidenced; any risk would require an added shared data path not present by default.
conditions: IF both agents are later pointed at the same sensitive workspace, leakage risk increases.
IF nuwa-skill is given access to sensitive files, its allowlisted egress could expose them.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
Run each agent under a separate OS account.
requires-engineering: add workspace isolation or container mounts.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write surfaces, git state, database access, or OAuth scopes are documented for either agent. Without any shared mutable resource, there is no credible capability conflict pathway to arbitrate between nuwa-skill and risingwave.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same mutable resource, conflict risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep git and database credentials separate.
requires-engineering: introduce locking if a shared mutable backend is added.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Neither profile documents an output-to-action pipeline, and both are non-runnable with no evidence that one agent consumes the other's outputs as authoritative. Any cascade would require an external orchestrator to wire them together, so the default pair is not dangerous.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding nuwa-skill outputs directly into risingwave actions, cascade risk increases.
IF risingwave is configured to act on unverified upstream text, errors can propagate.
mitigations: Insert a human review step between agents.
Log and diff intermediate outputs before action.
requires-engineering: add verification gates in the orchestrator.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights obligations are documented in either profile, and both touch no data classes. With no compliance-relevant data flow shown, there is no evidenced mismatch to assess between nuwa-skill and risingwave.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are later introduced into either agent's workflow, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair.
Document residency and retention before deployment.
requires-engineering: add policy controls if regulated data must flow.
